//: Frontend and API deploy as ONE Vercel project so they share an origin. That removes CORS entirely and lets the admin session live in a Secure httpOnly cookie.
buildCommand: cd frontend && yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn build
installCommand: echo 'Frontend dependencies are installed by buildCommand'
//functions: The whole FastAPI app is served by the single function at api/index.py. Hobby allows 12 functions per deployment; a per-route layout would waste them. 10s is the Hobby ceiling.
//rewrites: Order matters. /api/* reaches the Python function; everything else falls back to index.html for client-side routing. Vercel checks the filesystem before applying a rewrite, so real static assets are served directly and never hit the SPA fallback.

headers.//: API responses are per-user and must never be cached by a CDN or browser.
CRA fingerprints these filenames, so they are safe to cache forever.
